answer: The willow schedule is applied in wander and hollow exposes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 26% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2758 identities would post 3358 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
